evals.title: Irregular lab trend
evals.prompt: Plot a synthetic lab value measured 11 times over 9 months at irregular intervals.
evals.expected_output: Real time axis with points/line only where continuity is appropriate, exact value/unit access and visible gaps.
assertions: The visualization answers a named user question.
Exact values and units remain available when needed.
Time spacing and timestamps are honest.
Missing data is not silently interpolated or zeroed.
Reference/target semantics are sourced rather than invented.
Essential information has a non-color/non-hover path.
